## 2. Concrete implementation(s)

- `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` — `type service struct { md goldmark.Markdown }`. This unexported struct is the single runtime implementation, wrapping the `github.com/yuin/goldmark` library (imported at lines 7-12). Method implementations run from lines 143-453 (`RenderHTML` at :255 uses `goldmark`'s `Convert`; `parse` at :116 uses `s.md.Parser().Parse`).
- Supporting helper (not itself an implementation of the interface, but the AST-to-markdown renderer used by `RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag`): `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15` — `type MarkdownRenderer struct`, constructed via `NewMarkdownRenderer()` at :20, invoked at `markdown.go:250` and `markdown.go:451`.
- goldmark extensions/parsers that plug into the concrete service: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/parser/mention.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/tag.go`, `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/ast/mention.go`.

## 3. Who constructs the implementation

The factory is `NewService(opts ...Option) Service` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85` (returns `&service{md: md}` at :110). It configures goldmark with GFM plus optional tag/mention extensions (options `WithTagExtension` :71, `WithMentionExtension` :78).

- `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` — `Runner.MarkdownService markdown.Service`; constructor `NewRunner(store, markdownService markdown.Service)` at :19, assigned :22; consumed at :52 and in free function `RebuildMemoPayload(_, memo, markdownService markdown.Service)` at :74 (`ExtractAll` at :80).

Consumers using the interface via `s.MarkdownService` (holding it through `APIV1Service`):
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447` — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, ..., s.MarkdownService)`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` — `s.MarkdownService.ExtractAll(...)`.
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85` — `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(...)`.

## Frontend note (no interface abstraction)

The React side renders markdown directly, not behind an interface:
- `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx:4` imports `ReactMarkdown` from `react-markdown`; used at :144. So if "the interface markdown processing sits behind" means a swappable abstraction, the answer is exclusively the Go `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`) with its single goldmark-backed `service` implementation.</result>
